note: Every product that vendors this repository's engineering snapshot, and the values they are all expected to share. helpers/fleet-baseline.mjs runs INSIDE each product's CI and checks that product against this file, which it reads over plain HTTPS because this repository is public. Agreement with one baseline is agreement with each other, so no product ever reads another and nothing needs a credential.

profiles.service: Go or web backend deployed by komizo. Lints shell and workflows, runs the pin gate from scripts/test.sh.
profiles.godot: Godot game with a Go backend. Different client toolchain, so its node version and client-side tools are its own; everything shared with a service is still shared.

baseline.note: Slow-moving values only. Base image digests are deliberately absent: dependabot bumps those constantly and files the same bump in every product at once, so a table here would be wrong between the bump and somebody editing it. Digest agreement is what helpers/fleet-audit.py is for, run by an operator.
